# Koamishin — Full Technical Documentation & Architecture Specification

> Comprehensive system documentation for AI agents, developers, and autonomous systems interacting with the Koamishin collective ecosystem.

Website: https://koamishin.com
GitHub Organization: https://github.com/koamishin
Founded: 2024
License: MIT / AGPL-3.0

---

## 1. Overview & Mission

Koamishin is an independent developer collective focused on building high-performance, strictly typed, and deterministic web applications and open-source frameworks. The collective emphasizes:
1. Strict backend typing and deterministic logic (PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12/13).
2. Modern, accessible, high-performance user interfaces (Inertia.js, Vue 3, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4).
3. Bounded agentic systems where autonomous AI components are strictly separated from execution authority, policy enforcement, and financial movement.

---

## 2. Featured Projects & Architecture

### 2.1 OpenSinop (Circle Agent × Arc Network Hackathon)
- **Live URL**: https://opensinop.koamishin.com/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/koamishin/OpenSinop
- **Architecture**: Bounded Departmental Finance Orchestration
  - **Stage 01 (Agent Ingestion & Analysis)**: LLM agents parse vendor invoices, extract structured metadata, and draft disbursement proposals. The AI has zero chain credentials and read-only database permissions.
  - **Stage 02 (Deterministic PHP Policy Gate)**: Hard rules in pure PHP evaluate instant-cap rules (e.g. <= 50.00 USDC), remaining departmental budgets, and compliance checks. If any threshold is breached, the transaction halts and escalates to human review.
  - **Stage 03 (Settlement on Arc Testnet)**: Approved transactions call Circle Developer-Controlled Agent Wallets via the Lepton SDK, executing 6-decimal USDC settlements on Arc testnet with cryptographic receipts.
- **Stack**: Laravel 13, React 19, Inertia.js, Filament, Octane, Arc Testnet RPC, Circle Agent SDK.

### 2.2 KoamiStarterKit v2.0
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/koamishin/KoamiStarterKit
- **Purpose**: Modern opinionated Laravel starter kit designed for rapid enterprise setup.
- **Included Modules**:
  - Laravel 12 + Vue 3 + Inertia.js + Tailwind CSS 4
  - Laravel Fortify authentication (Two-Factor Authentication, Session Management)
  - Wayfinder typed routing
  - Laravel Octane high-performance execution
  - Pest PHP testing framework with 100% pre-configured test scaffolding
  - Automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows

### 2.3 Academic & Enterprise Platforms
- **koakademy**: Academic management platform for enrollment, billing, student lifecycles, and progressive web application (PWA) offline support.
- **KoaScholarships**: Scholarship application, document verification, and merit disbursement portal powered by Filament and Livewire.
- **konbi**: Convenience store POS and multi-outlet inventory tracking system.
- **konexus**: Enterprise School Management Information System (SMIS) for institutional departments and student grading.
- **Koattendance**: Shift scheduling and workforce timecard platform with biometric verification hooks.
- **koment**: Esports and tournament management software with dynamic bracket generation and match score feeds.

---

## 3. Quick Start Commands

### OpenSinop
```bash
git clone https://github.com/koamishin/OpenSinop.git
cd OpenSinop
composer install
npm install && npm run build
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
touch database/database.sqlite
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
php artisan lepton:doctor
php artisan app:demo
```

### KoamiStarterKit
```bash
git clone https://github.com/koamishin/KoamiStarterKit.git my-app
cd my-app
composer install
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
npm install && npm run build
php artisan serve
```
